enabled.title: Protection on
enabled.description: Turns all protection on or off.

clipboard.title: Clipboard protection
clipboard.description: Blocks dangerous commands that websites put in the clipboard.

paste.title: Sign-in link paste protection
paste.description: Blocks pasting sign-in links that carry an authorization code into websites.

protocols.title: Program link protection
protocols.description: Blocks links that open Script Editor, Windows search on remote folders and similar programs.

fullscreen.title: Fake full-screen page protection
fullscreen.description: Stops fake update pages from taking over the screen.

pageWarnings.title: Paste instruction warnings
pageWarnings.description: Warns about pages that tell visitors to paste something into Run or Terminal.

reputation.title: Reported site warnings
reputation.description: Warns about sites listed in public threat databases.

blockPage.title: Block known ClickFix sites
blockPage.description: Shows a full-page warning before a known ClickFix site loads.

web3.title: Blockchain loader warnings
web3.description: Warns when a site loads hidden code from a blockchain.

feedUpdates.title: Database updates
feedUpdates.description: Downloads the signed database and rules every hour.

trustedSites.title: Trusted sites
trustedSites.description: Sites that are never checked, for example internal tools.

customWarning.title: Message in warnings
customWarning.description: Extra text shown in every warning, for example the IT helpdesk contact.

lockSettings.title: Lock settings
lockSettings.description: Prevents users from changing any setting.
